# Pure Air Systems

> > Pure Air Systems manufactures versatile HEPA filtration and air purification systems for residential and commercial HVAC applications since 1985.

Pure Air Systems specializes in advanced air filtration technology, offering a comprehensive range of HPS and HS Plus filter systems with three-stage filtration capabilities. The company provides both products and educational resources to help customers optimize indoor air quality.

## Key Topics

- HEPA filters
- HPS 500
- HPS 350
- 600HS Plus
- 1200HS
- 2000HS
- Air filtration systems
- HVAC integration
- Replacement filters
- Carbon filters
- Three-stage filtration
- Indoor air quality
- Air purification
- Furnace filters
- Residential and commercial applications
